classification: Synthetic pilot appearance/correctness evidence; SwiftShader is not hardware performance evidence.

source.publicationNote: Published source commit and local capture commit have exactly the same Git tree. A later delivery commit adds evidence without changing captured production source bytes.

behavior.comparison: Sampled Journey world/cast/camera rounded to 1e-7 with explicitly pinned compositor zoom/roll/shake input; no whole-output camera/pixel equality or hardware timing claim.
behavior.compositorLimitation: Natural legacy compositor zoom springs differ on cold transport reconstruction; the raw Journey camera is compared with matching viewport input. Natural capture frames remain unpinned.

limitations: One deterministic synthetic song and seed; no full real-song listening evaluation.
Software WebGL via SwiftShader; no device FPS or hardware frame-time claim.
